entries.original: Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. To opt out, set `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`. ([#60617](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60617), [#60848](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60848))
entries.translated: Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. To opt out, set `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`. ([#60617](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60617), [#60848](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60848))
